T: One night. Five stops. Plenty of snacks.
D: A cab driver is forced to drive a hitman around Los Angeles for one very long night.
P: Serve the mains when they pull up at the jazz club.
S: Cab driver's pretzel, peanut and jerky mix
Pretzels, peanuts and cashews roasted in smoked paprika butter, with beef jerky
Pretzels, salted peanuts and cashews tossed in melted butter, smoked paprika and a little brown sugar, roasted at 160C for 15 minutes, cooled and tipped into paper bags with strips of beef jerky.
Double fried wings glazed in gochujang honey sauce
Wings coated in potato starch, fried at 160C for 8 minutes, rested, fried again at 190C until shattering, tossed in a glaze of gochujang, soy, honey and garlic, sesame on top.
Daniel's jazz club smoky devilled eggs
Daniel tells his old story about the night a trumpet legend walked in

Devilled eggs whipped with mayo, mustard and chipotle, topped with crispy bacon and smoked paprika, with warm olives in orange and fennel alongside. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Halve and whip the yolks with 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp mustard and 1 chopped chipotle in adobo, then pipe back in. Top with crumbled crispy bacon from 2 rashers and smoked paprika. Warm 250g mixed olives in 3 tbsp olive oil with strips of orange peel and 1 tsp fennel seeds for 5 minutes and serve alongside.
M: Lime and orange marinated skirt steak, seared and sliced into corn tortillas
Skirt steak marinated in lime, orange, garlic and cumin for 2 hours, seared over very high heat, rested, sliced against the grain, in warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and salsa roja.
Max's mum Ida in hospital, in the middle of it all

Chicken thighs simmered into a golden broth with onion, carrot and celery, shredded back in with egg noodles, dill, black pepper and a squeeze of lemon. Put 1kg chicken thighs on the bone in a pot with 2L water, an onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks and a bay leaf. Simmer gently for 1 hour, skimming. Lift out the chicken, shred the meat and dice the vegetables. Return both to the strained broth, add 200g egg noodles and simmer 5 minutes. Season well and finish with chopped dill and lemon juice.
W: Baked coconut custard in a sweet shortcrust shell
Blind-baked sweet pastry filled with desiccated coconut, eggs, sugar, butter and coconut milk whisked together, baked at 170C for 30 minutes until golden and set.
K: Strong dark roast coffee poured over sweetened condensed milk and ice

Strong dark coffee dripped over sweetened condensed milk, stirred and poured over ice in tall glasses, with a pinch of salt to sharpen it. Brew 500ml very strong coffee with 80g dark roast ground coffee. Put 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk in each of four tall glasses with a small pinch of salt. Pour 125ml hot coffee into each and stir until combined. Fill with ice, stir again and serve with a straw.

note.text: Stay calm and keep driving, Max. Dinner can wait, and the schedule can't.

winks: Coyotes crossing the road at night
A jazz club stop with a legend
Club Fever and its loud crowd
A gray suit and silver hair

dishes.n: Cab driver's pretzel, peanut and jerky mix
dishes.make_ahead: Keeps 1 week in an airtight tin

steps.text: Toss the pretzels, salted peanuts and cashews with melted butter, paprika and sugar.
Roast at 160C.
Cool.
Tip into paper bags with strips of jerky.

veg.n: Cab driver's pretzel, peanut and mushroom jerky mix
veg.make_ahead: Keeps 3 days in an airtight tin

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms thinly lengthways and toss with the soy, maple syrup and half the paprika.
Toss the pretzels, salted peanuts and cashews with the melted butter, the rest of the paprika and the sugar on a second tray.
Bake the mushrooms on a lined tray at 160C for 40 minutes, turning once, until dark and chewy. Add the tray of pretzels and nuts for the last 15 minutes.
Cool both trays.
Tip the mix into paper bags with the chewy mushroom strips.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the sauce up to 3 days ahead in the fridge; do the first fry up to 2 hours ahead, then fry again and toss just before serving

steps.text: Toss the wings in the starch.
Heat the oil to 160C and fry the wings in batches, then rest.
Fry again at 190C until shattering.
Simmer the gochujang, soy, honey and garlic until glossy.
Toss the wings in the sauce and top with sesame.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the sauce up to 3 days ahead in the fridge; batter and fry fresh, as the coating goes soft if it sits

steps.text: Whisk the starch, flour and cold water into a thin batter and toss the cauliflower through it.
Heat the oil to 160C and fry in batches for 4 minutes, then rest on a rack.
Fry again at 190C until shattering.
Simmer the gochujang, soy, honey and crushed garlic until glossy.
Toss the cauliflower in the sauce and top with sesame.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate the steak in the fridge up to 1 day ahead (at least 2 hours); sear, slice and warm the tortillas on the night

steps.text: Marinate the steak in lime and orange juice, garlic and cumin.
Sear over very high heat.
Rest, then slice against the grain.
Warm the tortillas. Chop the onion and coriander.
Serve in tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa roja.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the mushrooms in the fridge for 30 minutes up to 2 hours ahead; sear and serve on the night

steps.text: Marinate the mushrooms in the lime and orange juice, crushed garlic, cumin, salt and oil.
Sear over very high heat until charred and tender.
Slice into strips.
Warm the tortillas. Chop the onion and coriander.
Serve in tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa roja.
Line a tart tin with the pastry and blind-bake.
Whisk the coconut, eggs, sugar, melted butter and coconut milk.
Pour in and bake at 170C until golden and set.
Cool.

dishes.make_ahead: Brew the coffee up to 1 day ahead and chill it, then reheat until hot before pouring over the condensed milk

steps.text: Brew the ground coffee with the boiling water to make very strong coffee.
Put condensed milk and a pinch of salt in each of four tall glasses.
Pour hot coffee into each and stir until combined.
Fill with ice, stir again and serve with a straw.

s.n: Cab driver's pretzel, peanut and jerky mix
s.note: Pretzels, peanuts and cashews roasted in smoked paprika butter, with beef jerky
s.how: Toss 150g pretzels, 150g salted peanuts and 100g cashews with 40g melted butter, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp brown sugar. Roast at 160C for 15 minutes and cool. Tip into paper bags with strips of 100g beef jerky.

s.note: Double fried wings glazed in gochujang honey sauce
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings in 100g potato starch and fry at 160C for 8 minutes, rest, then fry at 190C until shattering. Simmer 2 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp soy, 3 tbsp honey and garlic until glossy. Toss and top with sesame.

m.note: Lime and orange marinated skirt steak, seared and sliced into corn tortillas
m.how: Marinate 800g skirt steak in lime, orange, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 2 hours. Sear over very high heat, rest and slice against the grain. Serve in 16 warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and a jar of salsa roja.

w.note: Baked coconut custard in a sweet shortcrust shell
w.how: Blind-bake a tart tin lined with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust. Whisk 200g desiccated coconut, 3 eggs, 150g sugar, 80g melted butter and 200ml coconut milk. Pour in and bake at 170C for 30 minutes until golden and set.

d.note: Strong dark roast coffee poured over sweetened condensed milk and ice
d.how: Brew 500ml very strong coffee with 80g dark roast ground coffee. Put 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk in each of four tall glasses with a small pinch of salt. Pour 125ml hot coffee into each and stir until combined. Fill with ice, stir again and serve with a straw.
